## Tesseract.js 5.1.1

The browser OCR library and worker are in `tesseract/`.

- Source: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
- License: Apache License 2.0 (`tesseract/LICENSE`)

## Tesseract.js Core 5.1.1

The WebAssembly OCR engine builds are in `tesseract-core/`.

- Source: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
- License: Apache License 2.0 (`tesseract-core/LICENSE`)

## English OCR data

The compressed English trained data file is in `tessdata/`.

- Source: https://tessdata.projectnaptha.com/4.0.0/eng.traineddata.gz
- License: Apache License 2.0 (`tessdata/LICENSE`)
